name: Hocking College
oos_note: Public 2-year college. Official Hocking tuition page (hocking.edu/tuition-fees, rates effective May 1, 2026) publishes a non-resident surcharge of $218/credit hour = $3,270/semester = $6,540/year on top of in-state. Out-of-state annual tuition & fees = known in-state $7,330 + $6,540 surcharge = $13,870.
